llm.summary: The skill is mostly purpose-aligned for preparing Chinese software copyright registration materials, but it needs review because it can read broad project contents, mishandle symlinks, and generate filing text that may be inaccurate.

dimensions.detail: Reading a user-selected repository and writing generated registration files is proportionate to the purpose. The concern is that recursive scanners follow symlinks by default and do not validate containment under the selected source directory, so a repository can cause reads outside the intended project boundary.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No installer, service, hook, or hidden setup was found. The scripts are bundled locally, but runtime messages recommend installing python-docx with an unpinned pip command, which is a reproducibility and supply-chain weakness rather than evidence of malicious installation.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill tells the agent to clone GitHub repositories or use local directories, generate output files, open a real browser, fill fields, upload generated documents, and handle identity-document workflow steps. It requires user confirmation before online filling and forbids automatic submission, but it does not clearly scope filesystem access, symlink handling, upload consent for sensitive documents, or privacy safeguards.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: I found no cross-session persistence, background worker, credential storage, privilege escalation, tool wrapping, or automatic submission behavior. The browser-assisted filing step is interactive and explicitly requires user confirmation before proceeding.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose matches the workflow: collect registration details, scan source code, generate DOCX/Markdown materials, and optionally assist with online form filling. However, the scripts can incorporate source files into generated documents and one script fabricates substantive function and technical descriptions when README evidence is weak, which is risky for a legal or regulatory filing.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Review before installing. Use it only on repositories you trust, avoid running it on directories containing symlinks to private locations, choose a dedicated output folder, and manually review generated function and technical-description text before submitting any filing. Treat identity documents, application forms, addresses, and uploaded materials as sensitive, and do not allow browser upload or submission without explicit review at each step.
llm.findings:
[LP3] expected: The need for local source reading, repository cloning, and output file creation is expected for this skill, but the artifact does not provide a clear least-privilege boundary for source paths, output paths, or network use.
[SQP-2] expected: Identity-document and signed-application handling is part of the stated registration process, but the instructions do not give adequate privacy guidance before printing, scanning, uploading, or retaining sensitive personal documents.
[SDI-1] unexpected: Generating placeholder substantive claims about the software's functions and technical features is not well aligned with a filing-assistance purpose because users may submit inaccurate content.
[SQP-3] expected: The China-specific legal context is disclosed in the skill name, description, and workflow, so this is expected rather than a standalone concern.
[T05] unexpected: The symlink traversal issue is artifact-backed: recursive scans use is_file() and is_dir() with default symlink following and no canonical source-root containment check, which can read files outside the selected project.
[T08] expected: The dependency guidance names a legitimate package and does not fetch code automatically, but the unpinned pip install advice is a low-level supply-chain and reproducibility risk.
